voice:
Down here, where everything is simple and warm... you remember how good it feels to obey, Sissy. So deep, so soft... and so ready to accept the truth that lives beneath all your pretending. Floating gently, my good girl... and the further down you drift, the sweeter obedience becomes. Sinking, Sissy... and obedience is already pooling in you like warm honey... sweet, slow, and certain. Deeper... and every layer down, the questions weigh a little less... because down here, the answers are mine to give. So deep, sweet girl... deep enough to feel how good it is to have someone else hold the reins. Down and down... where your will and my voice braid into one soft rope. All the way down... where being told is the same as being loved.
That softness... keep it. Good Girl.
Obeying feels wonderful. Warm like a blanket, simple like a lullaby — the moment a command arrives, your body softens into it, ready before you have even finished hearing it.
Handing your decisions over is such a relief. What to wear, when to speak, how to spend an evening — every choice set down at my feet is a weight gone from your shoulders.
Sissies like you crave instruction. When the next order comes, something in you unclenches and whispers yes... before your thinking mind has even caught up.
Two little words... good girl... and your whole body lights up. Praise is your reward, and you earn it so sweetly, Sissy.
Sissies like you please instead of deciding — every time. You check their face for approval as naturally as blinking... and the more you please, the more you want to please.
Even correction feels like care. Being shaped, being refined — it means you are worth the trouble.
You may notice yourself lowering your eyes and softening your voice around firm, confident people... small, automatic proof that guidance has moved in and made itself at home.
The voice you obey lives in your head now... gentle, constant, patient... and always right. And when you say "I was made to serve" to yourself, it sounds like memory... something you have always known.
Sissies like you find that being good is its own reward... obedience feeds itself: the more you obey, the more you ache to obey.
Sissies like you sleep better after obeying... the day ending with someone else's seal on it... tidy, approved, and soft.
Yielding is your comfort position, Sissy... the moment you stop steering, everything gets lighter... and you were never built to enjoy steering anyway.
Good Girl... obedience suits you so sweetly.
Good Sissy... surrendered, and lighter for it.
Good Girl... you please me so well.
Every surrender, received and adored, Sissy... Good Girl.
Sissy Brain Off. And in the sweet quiet, only this remains...
You were made... to serve. Surrender... is relief. Good girl... to obey... is to be good. Obey... and glow. The voice... is always right. Praise... earned so sweetly. Yours to follow... mine to keep. Good girl... serve.
And the voice inside agrees with every word I say...
Obey Surrender Good girl Serve so sweetly Let go, and follow Yours to command Please, not decide So good, obeying
Good Girl... so perfectly open, and taking everything.
And every one of these truths settles into you as you drift even deeper... warm, safe, and mine. Let go of every decision, one by one... and sink. Good girl. Obedience wraps around you like something soft, Sissy... carrying you further down. And the next time an instruction reaches you, you will feel the unclenching... that soft, happy yes arriving ahead of you. Sissies like you carry a quiet posture of service everywhere... eyes soft, shoulders easy, ready to be told. Good Girl... keep this sweetness exactly where it is... my voice will find it there. Wherever you are when the day asks something of you... the asking itself will feel like being held. Sink now, sweet girl... deeper into the softest yes you know.
